name: Hywind Tampen floating wind farm, North Sea (Equinor)
description: 88 MW, 11 floating turbines, world's largest floating wind farm; first power 13 Nov 2022; powers Snorre and Gullfaks oil and gas platforms

sources.note: JPT, 22 Nov 2022 (first power 13 Nov 2022); Maritime Executive, 8 Apr 2020 (investment close to NOK 5 bn, about USD 488 m; NOK 2.3 bn Enova support per Windpower Monthly); read 2026-10-28
